system.description:
Deal [[/r 2d6 + @battle-status.power.attack.total]]{[(SR+1)D + (Attack Power)]}  physical damage to the target.

You may make the target [Safe Move (Forced)] up to 1 Sq, but they must move closer to you.

A skill that shoots arrows that make a special wind noise. A unique sound resembling the cry of a bird of prey excites the enemy and has the effect of inviting the shooter to charge.
